declarations.normative_text: Follow the references: model-data-delta-seed names; H:/Expect:/Outcome notes; family/arch/train/data/provenance config; namespaced metrics on one step axis with summaries; artifact cards, metadata and pinned lineage; rank-zero logging and persistent requeue ids.

Never judge success or convergence. Record verdicts from hanig-verified-workflow contracts and hanig-swarm/converge.py predicates. Expect quotes the predicate declared before the run. Label post-result checkpoint selection post hoc in card caveats.
Use available host capabilities and authorized W&B access. Callers pass W&B or Api explicitly; shipped scripts import only stdlib. Missing access blocks the logging check.
Set HANIG_WANDB_LOGGING_DIR to the loaded SKILL.md directory; locate programs there and keep data/output paths project-relative.
Never send config values under secret-pattern keys or use them in generated names/notes. Redact argv credentials; check custom free text.

Show a concrete logging plan; resolve new project/entity/group choices with the user. Show exact run renames, notes/tags rewrites, shared card edits or registry promotions and obtain confirmation first. Never delete runs or artifact versions as cleanup.
